capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

checklists.name: IBM DB2 Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DB2 SQL dialect, isolation levels, index optimization, and REORG/RUNSTATS maintenance.

items.statement: SQL queries explicitly specify necessary isolation levels (e.g. Cursor Stability CS, Read Stability RS) to prevent lock contention.
Index cardinality and column ordering are optimized to avoid DB2 lock escalation and table-level locks.
db2expln utility is run to inspect access paths and ensure index scan vs table scan choices align with volume expectations.
REORG and RUNSTATS maintenance schedules are defined for high-churn DB2 tablespaces.
Prepared statements with parameter markers are used for all dynamic SQL invocations.

obligationDefinitions.title: DB2 catalog statistics and index health must be refreshed on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: Stale optimizer statistics and fragmented indexes silently degrade DB2 query performance over time; RUNSTATS/REORG must be run on a recurring cadence, not only reactively once a query regression is reported.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Catalog statistics and index health are refreshed within the declared maintenance cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: Catalog statistics refresh record
requiredEvidence.description: DB2 maintenance job log showing RUNSTATS/REORG execution and timing.
